insight: Run by Anlatan with no outside VC — funded entirely by subscriptions; its 2026 Xialong model is a GLM-4.6 storytelling fine-tune.
name: NovelAI
tagline: Subscription AI storyteller and anime image generator with encrypted stories.
description: NovelAI is a subscription platform for AI-assisted fiction writing and anime-style image generation, built around Anlatan's own storytelling models rather than general-purpose assistants. Paid tiers include unlimited text generation with adjustable context sizes, plus Anlas credits for its NAI Diffusion image models. Stories are stored end-to-end encrypted, so only the author can read them.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary in-house storytelling and anime image models.

edge: Unlimited text generation on every paid tier plus anime-focused image models, with stories stored end-to-end encrypted.

cons: Best text model locked to $25 Opus tier
